spans.s: धिष r. 3rd cl. (दिधेष्टि) To emit sound. जु० प० अक० सेट् ।

धिषण m. (-णः)
 1. A name of VṚ

. Any Guru or spiritual
preceptor.
 f. (-णा) The understanding, the intellect.
 E. धृष् to be
presumptuous, Unādi affix क्यु, and धिष substituted for the root.

धिष्ण्य n. (-ष्ण्यं)
 1. A place, a spot, a country.
 2. A house.
 3. A star, an
asterism.
 4.

. Power. strength.
 m. (-ष्ण्यः) A name of AGNI,
the deity of fire.
 2. A name of SUKRA, regent of VENUS.
 E. धृष् to
be proud or overbearing, deriv. irr.; or more correctly. धृष-ण्य-नि०
the word is also written धिष्ट्य or धिष्ठ्य ।

धीशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) An intellectual faculty or power of the understanding,
as attention, comprehension. &c.
 E. धी the intellect, and शक्ति
power.

धीसख m. (-खः)
 1. A counsellor, an adviser, a minister.
 2. A tutor or
friend.
 E. धी the understanding, and सखि a friend.

धीसचिव m. (-वः)
 1. A counsellor, a minister.
 2. A friendly or prudent
adviser.
 E. धी the intellect, and सचिव a friend.
